credits.title: Credits & sources
credits.art: Panel illustrations were created with AI image tools (Google Gemini) under Team Helios art direction, and are dramatizations. Archival photographs: NASA/JPL-Caltech and NASA, credited individually. 3D hardware models: courtesy NASA/JPL-Caltech (NASA 3D Resources), optimized and art-directed by Team Helios.
credits.labels: Every image is labelled ILLUSTRATION or ARCHIVAL. Speech balloons are fictionalized narration; caption boxes and hotspot facts are documented history. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA.
credits.narration: Narration voices generated with {provider} (AI-generated speech) and pre-rendered at build time; translations machine-assisted and under review.
credits.narrationDevice: All narration audio is pre-rendered at build time and served as static files.
credits.translation: Hindi, Spanish, French and Portuguese (Brazil) translations are machine-assisted and under review. Names, numbers and hardware names are kept exactly as in the English source.

rover.caption.intro: Your commands reach Mars minutes later. Plan one sol, then uplink.
rover.caption.firstUplink: Radio signal beaming to Meridiani Planum. Wait for telemetry.
rover.caption.firstSandSlip: Soft sand ahead — the wheels are slipping in loose drifts.
rover.caption.rockStop: Hazard avoidance halted the drive before hitting a rock.
rover.caption.lowBattery: Power is running low. Keep the next sol short to recharge.
rover.caption.win: Hematite blueberries scanned! Water once shaped this Martian plain.
rover.caption.lose: Telemetry lost before scanning the outcrop. Review and try again.
